text.$description: Body text. Contrast with background is tested (WCAG AA).

text-muted.$description: Secondary text; still AA on background and surface.

border.$description: Card borders: at least 3:1 against background (non-text contrast).

accent.$description: Call-to-action button background; text on it is background.

focus.$description: Focus outline: at least 3:1 against background and surface.
